title: LA Colossal – Son Mai 03 (Standing)
prompt:

Background & Lighting: Hoi An old house courtyard with hanging lanterns, softly blurred. Low camera angle, 85mm lens. Warm lantern light with raking side light. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame. Emphasis on the extremely large SuperBBW body volume. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
